content.title: Chapter 102 - UTILITIES — Sec. 102-251. - Groundwater underlying lands.
content.summary:
All groundwater in the Denver, Arapahoe, and Laramie-Fox Hills aquifers underlying
               lands included within the corporate limits of the city as of January 1, 1985, is hereby
               incorporated into the municipal service plan of the city.
(Code 1981, § 33-200; Ord. No. 2574, § 1,…
